rationale: 1024 bits gives a median of 256 carrier tokens and a mean of 253, matching the scale of the 256-token streaming experiments.
BPT remains stable at about 4 bits per token.
Both KL directions and TVD remain at numerical zero after the Decimal-boundary fix.
512 bits has the same 7/8 end-to-end result but only a 130-token median, so it does not provide a reliability advantage that justifies the shorter comparison scale.
